Definition: from G4209; purpureal, i.e. bluish red:--purple.
BiblicalUsage: Porphyrous is the adjective, purple, purplish red. John uses it twice for the purple robe the soldiers put on Jesus, and Revelation for the woman arrayed in purple and scarlet.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the colour of kings was put on the true King in scorn, and heaven will answer that scorn one day.
